landing.hero.searchAria: Ask about a book or an idea
landing.hero.hint: Try: "books like The Overstory but shorter" or "explain Ibn Khaldun's theory of ʿumrān".
landing.demo.q1: Books like al-Ṭabaqāt al-Kubrā, but shorter
landing.demo.a1: I surfaced 4 shorter biographical compendia, ranked by coverage span and page count — top pick is al-Mukhtaṣar fī Akhbār al-Bashar by Abū al-Fidāʾ.
landing.demo.q2: Explain the end of chapter four of al-Fuṣūṣ
landing.demo.a2: The chapter closes by tying the divine names to the fixed entities, noting a subtle divergence between the Damascene and Qūnawī recensions of the manuscript.
landing.demo.q3: Find passages where the author discusses justice and excellence
landing.demo.a3: Found 7 passages across 3 books — best match is a section in Iḥyāʾ ʿUlūm al-Dīn linking the concept to the ethics of public stewardship.

landing.howHeadline: The whole product, in one page.
landing.howSubhead: The book page on one side, the reading assistant on the other — you ask, it answers with citations to the text.
landing.how.sample1: When you study the conditions of urban organisation, you find they follow steady patterns that mix the simplicity of tribal origin with the complexity of the state.
landing.how.sampleHighlight: Group solidarity is the foundation of rule — when it dissolves, the state loses its first pillar.
landing.how.sample2: And the phases of the state have fixed lifespans, each carrying signs by which it can be known.
landing.how.item1.title: Highlight a passage — get the context
landing.how.item1.text: Hover any sentence to surface historical background and cross-references from other books.
landing.how.item2.title: Ask who that is
landing.how.item2.text: Identify any figure mentioned, with a concise biography and links to the books that chronicle them.
landing.how.item3.title: Request a thematic read
landing.how.item3.text: Extract the book's arguments or a single chapter, with in-text citations you can jump into.
landing.how.item4.title: Cross-reference other works
landing.how.item4.text: See how the same concept was treated by different authors across centuries.

home.hero.titleEm: that reads with you.
home.hero.subtitle: ILM Shamela indexes 1,400 years of scholarship across four languages — then answers your questions with a citation, never a guess.
home.trust.label: Trusted by scholars at
home.why.body: Most search engines flatten knowledge into ten blue links. ILM treats each text as it deserves — with provenance, edition, and context preserved. Your reading is private, your sources are verifiable, and your assistant never invents what isn't there.
home.feature.multilingual.title: Multilingual mastery
home.feature.multilingual.desc: Native handling of Arabic, English, Persian, and Urdu — including diacritics, ligatures, and right-to-left context.
home.feature.privacy.title: Privacy by design
home.feature.privacy.desc: Your queries, notes, and uploads stay encrypted. No training on your reading, ever. You own the corpus you build.
home.feature.citations.title: Citation-first answers
home.feature.citations.desc: Every reply links to the exact line in the exact edition. If a claim isn't in the corpus, ILM tells you so.
home.feature.manuscript.title: Manuscript-grade rendering
home.feature.manuscript.desc: Beautiful typography with proper kashida justification, marginalia support, and footnote linking.
home.shelf.body: From the formative period to the present, organized the way a librarian would. Click any spine to peer inside.
